The success metric is therefore not a defined metric.","evidence_quote":"Customer happiness: from 4.0 to 4.4 within 12 weeks.","citations":["metrics-glossary#deprecated-and-ambiguous-terms"],"recommendation":"Replace it with Delivery CSAT, keeping the baseline, target and timeframe, and use the canonical name."},{"type":"POLICY_REVIEW","title":"No Responsible AI review recorded for GenAI chatbot using customer data","detail":"The proposal deploys an LLM chatbot that identifies customers by phone number and reads their order history. The proposal records none; it only says vendor selection is in progress.","evidence_quote":"Vendor selection is in progress.","citations":["policy-compliance#generative-ai-with-company-data"],"recommendation":"Complete and record a Responsible AI review covering approved models, data handling of phone numbers and order data, and human oversight before launch."},{"type":"UNSUPPORTED_CLAIM","title":"60% deflection claim has no source","detail":"The 60% contact deflection is stated as an expectation with no supporting data, pilot, or benchmark.","evidence_quote":"We expect the chatbot to deflect 60% of contacts.","citations":[],"recommendation":"Cite a source such as a pilot, vendor benchmark, or historical analysis, or remove the figure or label it as an assumption to be tested."}]}
